a.speaker: dj
a.text: A detective at The Suno Club! Welcome in. Band’s on in five. It’s always five. This is where the agents come when their shifts finally end.

back.speaker: dj
back.text: Back already? Band’s still on in five.

choices.text: Where do the agents cut loose?

loose.speaker: dj
loose.text: Right here. The reserved booth goes to whoever had the worst week. Last week, a scheduling bot cried into a Soft Reset. The bandstand takes requests, too.

skye.speaker: dj
skye.text: She left a request last week. Said she’d be back to hear it.

end.speaker: dj
end.text: Ask the bar for a Sideband Reserve. Trust me.
